title: Connect to a server through a jump host
summary: Use SSH jumping to connect to a final destination server via an intermediate 'jump' server. This is useful when the final server is not directly accessible from your network.

steps.explain: Use the -J flag to specify the jump host. The SSH client will connect to the jump host first, then tunnel through it to the final remote host.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username on the final remote server

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP of the final remote server

placeholders.name: JUMP_USER
placeholders.description: The username on the jump host

placeholders.name: JUMP_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP of the jump host
